title: Traversée de phase
approval_scope: Full displayed RP, current/next values, costs/cooldown and target/landing/movement-reaction conditions accepted as provisional balance. Unshown full curves, detailed movement/stacking/turn cases and native visuals remain pending.
accepted_conditions: Visible adjacent enemy; movement to its opposite side, two tiles.
Landing free, known and passable; walls and closed doors block passage.
Dodge bonus added to ordinary dodge and available for reactions caused by movement.
unshown_rules_approval: Full rank curves, ordinary dodge/hit bounds, exact diagonal/corner geometry, large actor footprints, landing eligibility, path hazards and reaction ordering, two-turn duration accounting, recast/stacking with other dodge buffs, interrupted movement/refusal atomicity and attribute/implant cost interactions remain pending where not already accepted. No wall teleport, enemy displacement/control, damage, invulnerability, free attack, weapon requirement or hidden actor reveal introduced.
